{{Top}}
[[File:SebulbaGoggles-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] wearing goggles]]
'''Goggles''' were large [[spectacles]] equipped with special lenses and protective rims to prevent the eyes from injury.

==Overview==
Goggles were worn for many different reasons. They were often worn when performing dangerous jobs. They were also worn during different kinds of [[Racing (disambiguation)|racing]], such as [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]]. Goggles were often worn in environments with intense snow or sand storms such as [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]], [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

[[Sun-goggles]] were a specialized type of goggles that featured polarized lenses to protect from glaring [[Star/Legends|suns]] common on hot worlds, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Members of the [[Enso/Legends|Enso]] [[Species/Legends|species]] often wore such goggles to supplement the cooling properties of their [[coolth suit]]s on hot worlds.<ref name="DB CTR">{{DB|character|teyorarekab|Rekab, Captain Teyora}}.</ref>

==History==
[[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] often wore goggles. Due to [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], their home planet, having a unique atmosphere composed of [[Helium/Legends|helium]] and a [[Dorin gas/Legends|gas]] unique to their world, the Kel Dors were forced to wear an [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath mask]] and protective goggles whenever in atmospheres of a different composition. This equipment protected them from [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]], and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], which were fatal to a Kel Dor.

[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] utilized octagonal goggles while fixing the [[Jedi shuttle]] when she, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were trapped on [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]].

[[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] was usually wearing goggles.

[[Finn Galfridian]] owned a pair of goggles that linked up to his droid, [[Prowl]]. They allowed him to send Prowl to scout, while he stayed back in safety and watched.

[[Jan Ors]] often wears goggles when piloting the [[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]], or when fixing machines.
